column3: (Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: false positive, the word "user" inside React Router's minified code, not a comment)
(Modern Web Application: informational, says the site is a JavaScript app; the scan already uses the AJAX spider for that)

(Information in Browser Storage: the alert is the shopping cart in sessionStorage. Known limitation: the login token is in localStorage, readable by any XSS; the strict CSP reduces that risk, and moving the token to an HttpOnly cookie is planned)
(Storable and Cacheable Content: informational and intended; hashed build files are cached for a year, index.html is revalidated on every visit, API responses are not cached by Nginx)
